verdict.rationale: The only evidence of quantization is community commentary. One comment mentions an IVF_SQ8H index, a GPU rebuild of FAISS IVF SQ8 scalar quantization. Another mentions 'different IVF variants' and disk-based search. Neither shows first-party documentation for enabling compression or describes the accuracy cost. Missing for 10: first-party docs on quantized index types (e.g. SQ/PQ), configuration steps, a documented recall-vs-memory/storage trade-off, and hands-on corroboration of cost savings.
